qualifies_reason: Independent non-profit architecture journal with Log 67 (Summer 2026) on sale from the publisher's own store.
what_it_is: A text-led journal of architectural criticism and commentary that covers buildings, cities, technology and design culture through essays, interviews and short observations rather than image spreads. Issues are mostly open-themed, with occasional thematic numbers. It is aimed at architects, students, scholars and others who follow architectural thinking closely.
